tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on TAMP
tables.text: Table 599, "Effect of low-power modes on TAMP", in section 62.4 (TAMP low-power modes) on page 3074. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s).

rows:
No effect.
TAMP interrupts cause the device to exit the Sleep mode.

No effect on all features, except for level detection with filtering and active tamper modes 
which remain active only when the clock source is LSE or LSI.
TAMP interrupts cause the device to exit the Stop mode.

No effect on all features, except for level detection with filtering and active tamper modes 
which remain active only when the clock source is LSE or LSI.
TAMP interrupts cause the device to exit the Standby mode.
